brief: The opening page of a luxury fashion house's autumn editorial. Maison Verrier. Autumn–Winter 2027. The Quiet Hour. Twelve looks photographed at dawn in Lisbon. Brand: Maison Verrier.
A poster for an experimental electronic music night. RESONANT BODIES. Live sets: Kaito Mura · Elsa Varga · Null Field. Friday 7 March, 23:00 until late. Halle 4, Leipzig. Tickets at the door.
An announcement post for a contemporary architecture studio. Studio Halvorsen Lund. New work: The Salt Store, Bergen — a 1902 harbour warehouse turned into a public library. Opening 21 May.
The cover of an independent literary journal. The Lantern Review. Issue 12: Thresholds. New fiction, poetry and essays. With work by Amara Osei, Tomás Riera and Lena Holm.
A launch post for a children's educational brand that teaches maths through play, for ages 4 to 8. Counting Owls. Numbers you can hold. Free trial box this month.

A landing page for Ledgerline, an app that sets aside tax automatically for freelancers. Sections: the promise (Tax, put aside before you spend it), how it works in three steps (connect your account, choose your rate, we hold it in a separate pot), pricing (Free; Pro £6 a month), security (FCA-regulated, bank-grade encryption), and a sign-up.
A poster for an exhibition of brutalist-inspired sculpture and concrete casts. CAST / RECAST. Works by Ines Albrecht. 12 April – 30 June. Galerie Béton, Brussels.

The cover of a brochure for a traditional law firm, established 1898, specialising in estates, trusts and family property. Hartley & Pryce, Solicitors. Guiding families through generations. Offices in York and Harrogate.
The cover of an experimental science publication about open questions in physics. Unresolved. Issue 03: What is time made of? Essays, diagrams and dissent from working physicists.
A logo for a premium boutique hotel in a restored eighteenth-century olive mill in Puglia: Masseria Lume. Twelve rooms, a kitchen garden, slow mornings.
